invariant: A script may read only the values of scripts that finished above it; reading a name that belongs to a script at or after its own position is a failed execution, not a stale or absent value.

scenario.hostInput: a note whose scripts run sequentially in document order, with the values of the finished ones available to the view
scenario.guestCode: read a name produced above; read a name produced below; read the guest's own name; read a name no script carries

mustHold: a name produced above reads back as that value
a name produced below, and the script's own name, fail the execution
the failure is classified 'script-error': it claims no capability was denied and no tier blocked it
the reported message is the host-recorded sentence, not text that crossed the guest boundary, so a guest cannot forge it and a guest's own error cannot displace it
a name no script carries, and a name whose script failed, both read as absent rather than failing
